from rdflib import Graph, Namespace
from datetime import date

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

uni = Namespace("http://university.org/ontology/")
ref_date = date(2025, 8, 16)

# Map courses to departments
course_to_dept = {}
for triple in g.triples((None, uni.isTaughtIn, None)):
    course = triple[0]
    dept = triple[2]
    course_to_dept[str(course)] = str(dept).split("/")[-1]

# Map departments to countries
dept_to_country = {}
for triple in g.triples((None, uni.belongsTo, None)):
    dept = triple[0]
    uni_obj = triple[2]
    country = g.value(uni_obj, uni.locatedInCountry)
    dept_to_country[str(dept).split("/")[-1]] = str(country)

# Get active students per course
print("=== ACTIVE STUDENTS PER COURSE ===")
course_active = {}
for course_str in course_to_dept:
    course_uri = None
    for triple in g.triples((None, uni.isTaughtIn, None)):
        if str(triple[0]) == course_str:
            course_uri = triple[0]
            break
    if course_uri is None:
        continue
    active = set()
    for student in g.subjects(uni.isEnrolledIn, course_uri):
        ed = g.value(student, uni.hasEnrollmentDate)
        if ed and ed.toPython() <= ref_date:
            gd = g.value(student, uni.hasGraduationDate)
            if gd is None or gd.toPython() > ref_date:
                active.add(str(student).split("/")[-1])
    course_active[course_str] = active
    print(f"  {course_str}: {len(active)} active: {sorted(active)}")

# Get active students per department
print("\n=== ACTIVE STUDENTS PER DEPARTMENT ===")
dept_active = {}
for course_str, active in course_active.items():
    dept = course_to_dept[course_str]
    if dept not in dept_active:
        dept_active[dept] = set()
    dept_active[dept] |= active

for dept, students in dept_active.items():
    country = dept_to_country.get(dept, "UNKNOWN")
    print(f"  {dept} ({country}): {len(students)} active: {sorted(students)}")

# Full professors
print("\n=== FULL PROFESSORS ===")
for triple in g.triples((None, uni.role, None)):
    person = triple[0]
    role_str = str(triple[2])
    if "Professor" in role_str and "Assistant" not in role_str:
        name = g.value(person, uni.hasName)
        works = list(g.objects(person, uni.worksIn))
        print(f"  {name}: works in {[str(w).split('/')[-1] for w in works]}")

from rdflib import Graph, Namespace, Literal
from datetime import date

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

uni = Namespace("http://university.org/ontology/")

query = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema/>

SELECT ?professorName (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?country; separator=", ") AS ?countries)
WHERE {
  ?professor a uni:Person ;
             uni:hasName ?professorName ;
             uni:role ?role ;
             uni:worksIn ?dept .

  FILTER(CONTAINS(?role, "Professor"))
  FILTER(!CONTAINS(?role, "Assistant"))

  ?dept uni:belongsTo ?university .
  ?university uni:locatedInCountry ?country .

  FILTER(?country IN ("AT", "BE", "BG", "HR", "CY", "CZ", "DK", "EE", "FI", "FR", "DE", "GR", "IE", "IT", "LV", "LT", "LU", "MT", "NL", "PL", "PT", "RO", "SK", "SI", "ES", "SE"))

  {
    SELECT ?professor (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?studentCount)
    WHERE {
      ?professor uni:worksIn ?dept .
      ?course uni:isTaughtIn ?dept .
      ?student uni:isEnrolledIn ?course ;
               uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?enrollDate .
      FILTER(?enrollDate <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
      OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gradDate }
      FILTER(!BOUND(?gradDate) || ?gradDate > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
    }
    GROUP BY ?professor
    HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) > 10)
  }
}
GROUP BY ?professorName
"""

results = g.query(query)
for row in results:
    print(f"  {row.professorName} | {row.countries}")

for w in works:
    uni_obj = g.value(w, uni.belongsTo)
    country = g.value(uni_obj, uni.locatedInCountry)
    print(f"  {str(w).split('/')[-1]} -> {str(uni_obj).split('/')[-1]} -> {country}")

query = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema/>

SELECT ?professorName ?country
WHERE {
  ?professor a uni:Person ;
             uni:hasName ?professorName ;
             uni:role ?role ;
             uni:worksIn ?dept .

  FILTER(CONTAINS(?role, "Professor"))
  FILTER(!CONTAINS(?role, "Assistant"))

  ?dept uni:belongsTo ?university .
  ?university uni:locatedInCountry ?country .

  FILTER(EXISTS {
    ?professor uni:worksIn ?euDept .
    ?euDept uni:belongsTo ?euUni .
    ?euUni uni:locatedInCountry ?euCountry .

  })

      OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gradDate }
      FILTER(!BOUND(?gradDate) || ?gradDate > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
    }
    GROUP BY ?professor
    HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) > 10)
  }
}
"""

results = g.query(query)
for row in results:
    print(f"  {row.professorName} | {row.country}")
